name: Kangchenjunga
note: Not in Natural Earth's elevation points. Third highest mountain on Earth, on the Nepal-India (Sikkim) border.

name: Makalu
note: Not in Natural Earth. Fifth highest, south-east of Everest, on the border with China (shown on Nepal's sheet: on China's it would crowd Everest).

name: Cho Oyu
note: Not in Natural Earth. Sixth highest, west of Everest, on the border with China (shown on Nepal's sheet, as Makalu).

name: Annapurna
note: Not in Natural Earth. Tenth highest; the Annapurna range is Nepal's best known trekking region.

name: Jungfrau
note: Not in Natural Earth. With the Eiger and the Mönch, the best known peaks of the Bernese Alps.

name: Eiger
note: Not in Natural Earth. Its north face is one of the most famous climbs in the Alps.

name: Mount Fitz Roy
aliases: Cerro Fitz Roy|Cerro Chaltén|Monte Fitz Roy
note: In Natural Earth at 3,375 m; 3,405 m is the height usually given. On the Argentina-Chile border.

name: Barre des Écrins
note: Not in Natural Earth. The highest peak of the French Alps outside the Mont Blanc massif.

name: Vignemale
note: Not in Natural Earth. The highest peak of the French Pyrenees, on the border with Spain.

name: Mont Ventoux
note: Not in Natural Earth. The 'Giant of Provence', famous from the Tour de France.

name: Gran Paradiso
note: Not in Natural Earth. The highest mountain entirely in Italy.

name: Watzmann
note: Not in Natural Earth. Germany's best known mountain after the Zugspitze, in the Berchtesgaden Alps.

name: Cotopaxi
note: Not in Natural Earth. One of the highest active volcanoes on Earth.
